retrieval.rag_summary:
Metecno Aluminium Glass Foil Tape
represents heavy-duty reinforced aluminum glass-cloth tape distributed for vapor
sealing and air-tight jointing on insulated panels and HVAC duct systems.
Featuring high tensile strength fiberglass scrim reinforcement and an aggressive
pressure-sensitive adhesive, it creates impermeable vapor barriers across panel
seams in coolrooms, food processing facilities, and commercial buildings.
